notes: Most UMN hosts (Graduate School, catalog, CSE, Carlson, Humphrey, Law, CLA, online.umn.edu, Duluth) answer robots.txt with HTTP 403, so only the School of Public Health (sph.umn.edu) and CEHD's OLPD department (olpd.umn.edu) were collected. SPH programmes use the school-wide requirements their pages link to; Executive MPH, MHA and Executive MHA were skipped as closed to international/visa students. Deadlines on these pages give no year and were left out.
